payload.title: List and filter published articles with predictable pagination
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a application developer, I want filtered paginated published article lists, so that I can build article streams and section views.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: List and filter published articles with predictable pagination
  Scenario: Traverse a filtered list
    Given a publication has more published articles than one page can hold
    When I request a section-filtered list and follow its continuation information
    Then each page contains only matching eligible published articles in documented stable order
    And page size bounds, tie breaking and end-of-list behavior are documented
    And traversal of an unchanged published snapshot has no duplicate or missing articles
  Scenario: Handle changes and invalid parameters
    Given published content changes between page requests
    When I continue a listing or submit an invalid filter or page request
    Then the contract documents change consistency and returns predictable continuation or validation behavior
    And no draft or another publication's content appears
```

Keep filters minimal: publication and section; add further filters only for demonstrated application needs. Do not promise arbitrary query language or implement pagination now.
